author: lisalikeszelda
quote: 13 year wait for literally what, this game is not worth it, nearly 100 quid just to get the full game is disgusting, including many glitches and bugs, frame drops, boring storyline that only starts to get good after over 24 hours of playtime, and the one time we get a female protagonist shes sexualised, this game is just a porno in disguise

author: lisalikeszelda
quote: the most amazing game ever, oot n64 was my first ever zelda game when i was 5, i was playing it with my brother and it was so magical. when this game came out, it just captured the essence of what makes zelda so special and beautiful, from the storyline to the characters to the music and items and dungeon layouts, this game is a true fairytale and blessing
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
